column1: # APSE prophage integration site in Hamiltonella defensa S03 (strain H28).
# Coordinates are 1-based inclusive and refer to the delivered 2024 curated
# contigs, so they can be applied to the published assembly.
# att_core is the direct repeat duplicated by integration; it is present once in
# the uninfected chromosome (attB) and once in the free phage (attP), and twice
# (attL, attR) once the prophage is in place.
# The core here is the canonical integrase-A core, byte-identical to the one
# found in S05 and S07, and it occurs exactly once in the chromosome and once in
# the phage. The phage occurrence is on the opposite strand, so the phage is
# S03 has the thinnest placement evidence in the panel: 14 reads cross the
# junction against 4 running continuously across the empty site, at a chromosome
# coverage of about 9x. The ratio is consistent with the other samples but rests
# on far fewer reads, and it is recorded here rather than being presented as
# equivalent to the S05 and S07 sites.
